本次分析要支持哪一个研究或临床决策？: Which research or clinical decision should this analysis support?
终点名称、变化方向、单位；区分替代终点与临床结局: Endpoint, direction of change, and units; distinguish surrogate endpoints from clinical outcomes
观测时点、基线与随访时间窗: Observation time, baseline, and follow-up window
个体、动物、菌株、培养孔或组汇总；重复如何识别: Subjects, animals, strains, wells, or group summaries; identify the replicate structure
菌株/病原体、感染模型、部位及采样基质: Strain/pathogen, infection model, site, and sampling matrix
目标人群、器官功能、临床情景及排除范围: Population, organ function, clinical setting, and exclusions
total/free、血浆/组织、AUC/Cmax/T>MIC 及积分时间窗: Total/free, plasma/tissue, AUC/Cmax/T>MIC, and integration window
测定方法、物种/基质匹配、文献或数据来源: Assay method, species/matrix matching, and literature or data source
给药途径、剂量单位、频次、输注时长与操作约束: Route, dose units, frequency, infusion duration, and practical constraints
监测指标、毒性终点、阈值依据；无证据时保留缺口: Monitoring measures, toxicity endpoints, and threshold sources; retain evidence gaps
动物/体外到人体的桥接、物种差异、缺失 human PK: Animal/in vitro-to-human bridge, species differences, and missing human PK
通过标准、敏感性分析、不可评估项及补数据条件: Acceptance criteria, sensitivity analyses, non-assessable items, and data requirements
只压缩 proposal · 保留附件引用: Compress the proposal; retain attachment references
确认 PD 终点 · 分配 context 和数据: Confirm endpoints; route context and data
按任务与项目 rules · 不足则补证据: Assess the task; identify missing evidence
浓度–时间 · 剂量关系 · 解释边界: Time profiles, dose relationships, and limits
检索证据 · 只压缩 proposal: Retrieve evidence; compress the proposal only
proposal 唯一且可读，文件类型与角色正确: One readable proposal; file types and roles are correct
实际数据和文献附件已登记，保留来源及缺失状态: Data and evidence attachments are registered with provenance and missingness preserved
科研任务、药物、研究终点与约束提取完整: Research objectives, drug, endpoints, and constraints are captured
规则编号稳定；缺失信息不补造；附件路径可核验: Rule IDs are stable; missing information is not invented; attachment paths are verifiable
清洗、单位、给药、实验单位、缺失与 BLQ 处理已核对: Cleaning, units, dosing, experimental units, missing values, and BLQ handling are checked
实际规范化文件存在；数据充分性经人工确认: Normalized files exist; data adequacy has been reviewed by a human
按物种、个体/组汇总和基质分层，未把伪重复当样本量: Stratify by species, individual/group summaries, and matrix; do not count pseudoreplicates as independent units
异常与覆盖缺口有证据；需要改数据时返回 QC 重新审核: Anomalies and coverage gaps have evidence; changes to data return to QC for review
PD 终点、时间窗、实验单位、暴露定义及临床问题由人确认: A human confirms PD endpoints, windows, experimental units, exposure definitions, and clinical questions
临床与安全性证据不足标为 UNKNOWN，不编造阈值或人体参数: Missing clinical/safety evidence remains UNKNOWN; do not invent thresholds or human parameters
对应数据文件和模型已分配；index 暴露依赖与并行条件正确: Data and models are assigned; exposure dependencies and parallel execution conditions are correct
模型收敛、可辨识性、诊断和预测检验经审核: Convergence, identifiability, diagnostics, and predictive checks have been reviewed
动物暴露、人体外推和缺口明确区分: Animal exposure, human extrapolation, and evidence gaps are distinguished
暴露、MIC、结合率和终点有可靠匹配: Exposure, MIC, binding, and endpoints are reliably matched
同一响应和观测集比较；R²/AIC 最佳不等于已验证临床预测: Compare the same response and observations; the best R²/AIC does not establish clinical predictive validity
两个并行分支均已完成且审核通过: Both parallel branches have completed and passed review
每个结论可追溯到实际数据、模型与不确定性: Each conclusion is traceable to data, models, and uncertainty
PD 与临床结局的关系、适用人群和外推假设已审查: The PD-to-clinical-outcome relationship, target population, and translation assumptions have been reviewed
Regimen feasibility 与 Safety 分别评价，未知保持不可: Assess regimen feasibility and safety separately; unknowns remain unassessable
接受、补数据或修改问题的决定有依据；返回上游需建立新轮次: Acceptance, additional data, or revised questions have a rationale; upstream changes require a new cycle
按明确任务与项目规则判断，缺少判据则 NOT_CALCULABLE: Assess the defined task against project rules; missing criteria mean NOT_CALCULABLE
不足返回补证据；足够仅表示可进入数据准备，后续仍需 QC / EDA: Insufficient evidence returns upstream; adequate evidence permits preparation, with QC and EDA still required
本轮研究方案，压缩的唯一内容来源: This cycle's research proposal: the sole content source for compression
原始 PK、PD、给药、MIC、结合率等数据: Original PK, PD, dosing, MIC, binding, and related data
模型目录、文献、临床与安全性依据: Model catalog and literature, clinical, and safety evidence
文件 ID、角色、版本与去向: File IDs, roles, versions, and destinations
传给压缩步骤的方案文件引用: Reference to the proposal provided to compression
保留原值，直接供数据准备读取: Preserve original values for data preparation
模型目录与证据附件引用: References to model catalogs and evidence attachments
原 3.0 科研任务、药物、规则与缺口: Original 3.0 structure: objective, drug, rules, and gaps
只传文件引用，不把数据正文压缩进摘要: Pass file references; do not compress data contents into the summary
本步任务与清洗规则: Task and cleaning rules for this step
实际原始观测与给药数据: Actual original observations and dosing data
数据问题、处理记录、充分性与审核: Data issues, processing records, adequacy, and review
各数据集与实际文件引用: Dataset definitions and actual file references
按物种、基质、个体、时间整理的浓度数据: Concentrations organized by species, matrix, subject, and time
PD 终点、时间、菌株及实验单位: PD endpoints, times, strains, and experimental units
对应给药、MIC、结合率记录及来源: Matched dosing, MIC, binding records, and sources
字段、单位、BLQ/缺失定义与层级: Fields, units, BLQ/missing-value definitions, and data hierarchy
隔离数据及原因；不进入拟合: Quarantined data and reasons; excluded from fitting
实际规范化数据和字段字典: Actual normalized data and field dictionary
分析发现、覆盖不足、异常及候选分析范围: Findings, coverage gaps, anomalies, and candidate analysis scope
样本量、重复、缺失、BLQ、时间/剂量覆盖统计: Counts, replicates, missingness, BLQ, and time/dose coverage
PK 时间曲线、PD 分布、暴露覆盖与变量关系: PK time profiles, PD distributions, exposure coverage, and variable relationships
经审核的数据继续同行；EDA 不暗中修改数据: Reviewed data travel with the context; EDA does not silently modify data
EDA 发现与数据可用范围: EDA findings and usable data scope
同药物模型、临床/安全性证据与来源: Same-drug models and clinical/safety evidence with sources
PD 终点、临床问题、方案、安全性和转化假设的人工确认: Human confirmation of PD endpoints, clinical questions, regimens, safety, and translation assumptions
PK 分支任务、模型范围与数据文件引用: PK task, model scope, and data references
只包含 PK 分支所需物种、基质和给药记录: Only species, matrices, and dosing records needed by the PK branch
index 分支终点、候选指标与比较规则: Index endpoints, candidates, and comparison rules
匹配暴露、PD、MIC、结合率、实验单位: Matched exposure, PD, MIC, binding, and experimental units
各分支适用模型及对应文献引用: Applicable models and literature references for each branch
文件去向、依赖和 CPU 配额；暴露需 PK 生成时增加依赖: File destinations, dependencies, and CPU quotas; add a dependency when exposure must be predicted by PK
限定任务和已确认临床问题: Scoped task and confirmed clinical questions
实际 PK 观测及给药数据: Actual PK observations and dosing data
拟合比较、诊断、参数与限制: Fit comparisons, diagnostics, parameters, and limitations
暴露预测及来源；缺少桥接时不生成人体值: Exposure predictions and provenance; no human values without a supported bridge
诊断图、执行模型与复现入口: Diagnostic plots, executed model, and reproduction entry point
终点、时间窗与指标比较规则: Endpoints, windows, and index comparison rules
实际匹配的暴露、PD、MIC、结合率: Actual matched exposure, PD, MIC, and binding data
仅当 index 依赖本轮 PK 暴露时接收: Receive only when this cycle's PK predictions are needed for index screening
候选指标、最优模型与适用范围: Candidate indices, best-fitting model, and scope
R²、AIC/AICc/BIC、验证与不可计算项: R², AIC/AICc/BIC, validation, and non-calculable items
效应预测、不确定性和诊断图: Effect predictions, uncertainty, and diagnostic plots
参数表、预测表、模型比较与图表: Parameter tables, predictions, model comparisons, and figures
模型证据、限制与未解决问题: Model evidence, limitations, and unresolved questions
对应估计值、预测、不确定性和来源: Matched estimates, predictions, uncertainty, and provenance
审核后的诊断图与复现文件: Reviewed diagnostic plots and reproduction files
模型证据和原始临床决策问题: Model evidence and the original clinical decision question
给药可行性与安全性原始证据；不足则不可评估: Original feasibility and safety evidence; inadequate evidence remains unassessable
临床相关性、获益风险、外推边界与缺口: Clinical relevance, benefit-risk, translation boundaries, and gaps
各候选方案与途径、频次、输注、操作约束的对应判断: Candidate regimens assessed against route, frequency, infusion, and practical constraints
安全终点、阈值来源、适用人群和不确定性: Safety endpoints, threshold sources, applicable populations, and uncertainty
人工审核的解释；未验证项不视为临床推荐: Human-reviewed interpretation; unvalidated findings are not clinical recommendations
回到 QC / EDA / 问题分配的原因与改动，生成新轮次: Reasons and changes for returning to QC, EDA, or routing in a new cycle
明确估计目标、已知信息和证据缺口: Define estimands, known information, and evidence gaps
对照本次任务判断可计算性；没有通用样本量硬阈值: Assess calculability for this task; no universal sample-size cutoff
逐任务 SUFFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT / NOT_CALC: Task-level SUFFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT / NOT_CALCULABLE with rationale
缺少哪些变量、时间点、实验单位、精度或来源: Missing variables, time points, experimental units, precision, or sources
保留实际文件，足够时交给 QC: Retain actual files and pass them to QC when adequate
观测 Cmax/Tmax、明示积分窗的 AUC、幂模型斜率及 CI；不能计算的项: Observed Cmax/Tmax, AUC with explicit integration window, power-model slope and CI; retain reasons for non-calculability
完成线性、半对数、剂量标准化及 Cmax/AUC/Tmax–剂量检查；不能计算的: Check linear, semilog, dose-normalized, and Cmax/AUC/Tmax-versus-dose plots; explain unavailable plots
SC/PO 终末段排查 flip-flop；不凭曲线认定房室数或饱和机制: Consider flip-flop in SC/PO terminal phases; curves alone do not establish compartment count or saturation
幂模型报告斜率和 CI；剂量比例判据需事先确认，无判据不自动接受: Report power-model slope and CI; predefine dose-proportionality criteria; no automatic acceptance without criteria
已有本地/联网检索接口；证据逐篇核验后引用: Local/web search interfaces exist; verify each source before citing it
常规房室 PK 前的探索性分析；不含 PBPK；不自动判断房室数、机制或人体转化: Exploratory analysis before conventional compartmental PK modeling; excludes PBPK and does not automatically determine compartments, mechanisms, or human predictive validity.
同药物/分析物、物种、研究、给药途径、制剂、给药方案、基质、free/total: Compare within the same drug/analyte, species, study, route, formulation, regimen, matrix, free/total definition, and units; preserve subjects, occasions, batches, and summary-data levels.
缺少某图或统计量必需的定义时，该项 NOT_CALCULABLE，列明缺口；可用: If a required definition is missing, mark that panel/statistic NOT_CALCULABLE and list the gap. Describe usable data without guessing fields or silently pooling observations.
按剂量/时间/批次统计缺失、BLQ、独立动物数和记录数。: Count missing values, BLQ records, independent animals, and observations by dose, time, and batch.
PD 按终点、菌株、MIC、基线、时间窗和重复层级展示分布、time-kill: Stratify PD distributions, time-kill trajectories, and exposure coverage by endpoint, strain, MIC, baseline, time window, and replicate level.
PK–PD 匹配、free/total、血浆/组织定义在分配前由人工确认；EDA: A human confirms PK–PD matching, free/total exposure, and plasma/tissue definitions before routing; EDA does not replace model validation.
PLANNED_ONLY: 无数据时仅显示计划、字段和解释限制；不生成模拟科研结: PLANNED_ONLY: Without data, show the plan, fields, and interpretation limits; do not generate simulated research results.
分配器只转发对应分支需要的图表、数据引用和发现；不把本说明或全量研究背景复制给每: Route only the figures, data references, and findings each branch needs; do not copy this guide or the full research background into every model.
较晚或较平的峰可提出吸收速率、depot、溶解度/制剂限制等候选假设。: A later or flatter peak can motivate hypotheses about absorption rate, a depot, or solubility/formulation constraints.
公式成立，房室和终末斜率的解释须修正: Equations are valid; qualify compartment and terminal-slope interpretations
线性一室 IV bolus 的半对数轨迹为直线；线性二室可呈双相下降，可据此提出: A linear one-compartment IV bolus model is straight on a semilog plot; a linear two-compartment model may show two phases, suggesting candidate structures.
保留，不能由曲线直接认定机制: Retain; curves alone do not establish mechanisms
重合支持所研究条件与剂量范围内的剂量线性；系统性分离提示检查暴露的非比例性。: Overlap supports dose linearity under the studied conditions and dose range; systematic separation prompts investigation of non-proportional exposure.
线性、定常处置下，单次给药 AUC0-inf=F*Dose/CL；稳态给药区间: For linear, time-invariant disposition: single-dose AUC0-inf=F*Dose/CL; steady-state interval AUCtau=F*Dose_per_interval/CL. Do not substitute a truncated AUC into this identity.
Cmax、AUC、Tmax 与剂量: Cmax, AUC, and Tmax versus dose
AUC 接近成比例而 Cmax 低于比例且 Tmax 延后，与吸收变慢相容。: Approximately proportional AUC with less-than-proportional Cmax and later Tmax is compatible with slower absorption.
剂量幂模型与置信区间: Dose power model and confidence intervals
公式保留；用区间与预设界限判断: Retain the equation; assess intervals against prespecified bounds
b>1 / b<1 表示点估计上的超比例/低于比例；机制需另外检验。: b>1 / b<1 indicates a supra-proportional / sub-proportional point estimate; investigate the mechanism separately.
若 r=Dmax/Dmin>1，预设的剂量标准化暴露比界限为 [L,U]，则 b: For r=Dmax/Dmin>1 and prespecified bounds [L,U] on the dose-normalized exposure ratio, slope bounds are [1+ln(L)/ln(r), 1+ln(U)/ln(r)]. The entire CI for b must lie within these bounds to support proportionality under that criterion.
SC/PO：上升段、观测 Tmax、峰是否变平或延后、可能的 lag time。: For SC/PO, inspect the rising phase, observed Tmax, flatter/later peaks, and possible lag time.
不同剂量的观测 Cmax、下降过程、长尾；标记给药和采样时点。: Compare observed Cmax, decline, and tails across doses; mark dosing and sampling times.
逐个体/occasion 查看异常值及整体偏移，再按批次核查。: Inspect anomalies and shifts by subject/occasion, then investigate batches.
Tmax 也受处置过程及采样时间表影响；延后峰不证明吸收饱和或 depot。: Tmax also depends on disposition and the sampling schedule; a delayed peak does not establish absorption saturation or a depot.
高剂量组整体偏移也可能来自个体、批次或实际剂量差异；异常点只标记，删除须返回 Q: A shifted high-dose group may reflect subjects, batches, or actual doses. Flag anomalies; removal requires a return to QC and review.
IV bolus 不按吸收段解释；输注期间的上升需结合输注时长。: Do not interpret IV bolus profiles as an absorption phase; interpret infusion-related rises using infusion duration.
仅对真实可定量的正浓度使用对数纵轴；LLOQ 和 BLQ 另行标记。: Use a log axis only for genuinely quantifiable positive concentrations; mark LLOQ and BLQ separately.
观察可分辨的快、慢下降段与采样覆盖，不混接不同动物或 occasion。: Inspect distinguishable fast/slow phases and sampling coverage; do not connect different animals or occasions.
二室的 alpha、beta 是混合速率常数；beta 不等于 k10，受消除与: Two-compartment alpha and beta are hybrid rate constants; beta is not k10 and depends on elimination and tissue exchange.
SC/PO 终末段可能受慢吸收控制（flip-flop）；斜率变化不能直接归因于: Slow absorption may govern the SC/PO terminal phase (flip-flop); a slope change cannot be assigned directly to clearance.
弯曲也可来自持续吸收、非线性处置、批次/个体混合和 BLQ 选择；一条直线也不能: Curvature can reflect ongoing absorption, nonlinear disposition, mixed batches/subjects, or BLQ selection. A straight line does not exclude an unsampled distribution phase.
log10 图斜率为 -k/ln(10)，只有 ln 图斜率才是 -k；不能把图: The log10 slope is -k/ln(10); only the natural-log slope is -k. Do not interchange slopes.
叠加可比条件下的 C/Dose 曲线，分别查看峰部、尾部和全时间窗。: Overlay comparable C/Dose profiles; inspect the peak, tail, and full time window separately.
mg 与 mg/kg 不混用；写明标准化单位和体重处理。: Do not mix mg and mg/kg; state normalization units and weight handling.
重合不能单独证明 CL、V、F 各自不变；可能存在参数变化的相互抵消。: Overlap cannot establish that CL, V, and F are individually constant; parameter changes may offset each other.
局部 C/Dose 偏高或偏低不等于整体 AUC 超比例或低于比例；先检查一致积: Locally higher/lower C/Dose does not establish supra-/sub-proportional AUC; first check consistent integration windows.
同等定义下 AUC/Dose 反映 F/CL；高低变化既可能来自 F，也可能来自: Under matching definitions, AUC/Dose reflects F/CL; changes may arise from F, CL, or both.
峰更低更晚支持吸收变慢这一候选解释；终末斜率变化仍需排除吸收和分布因素。: A lower, later peak supports slower absorption as one hypothesis; terminal-slope changes still require assessment of absorption and distribution.
同时展示 Cmax、AUC、Tmax，明确观测值与模型预测值。: Show Cmax, AUC, and Tmax together; distinguish observations from model predictions.
AUC 标出积分窗、算法、数据层级、BLQ 策略以及是否外推。: Report the AUC window, algorithm, data level, BLQ policy, and any extrapolation.
这个组合不能证明 F 未变；F 和 CL 可同时变化。: This pattern does not establish unchanged F; F and CL may change together.
观测 Cmax/Tmax 对采样密度敏感；首点或末点为峰时报告覆盖风险。: Observed Cmax/Tmax are sensitive to sampling density; flag coverage when the first or last sample is the peak.
不同剂量的 AUClast 若截止时间不同，不当作同一暴露终点比较。: AUClast values with different last-sample times are not the same exposure endpoint.
稀疏破坏性采样/组均值可描述汇总曲线，但不能冒充逐动物 AUC 或获得个体间变异: Sparse destructive sampling/group means can describe summary profiles but cannot be treated as individual-animal AUC or provide between-animal variability.
输出 b、SE、CI、置信水平、剂量范围、独立实验单位数和拟合设计。: Report b, SE, CI, confidence level, dose range, independent experimental-unit count, and model design.
同一动物跨剂量/occasion 时采用处理相关性的模型；不把浓度采样点数作为独: Account for correlation when animals contribute multiple doses/occasions; concentration samples are not independent n.
CI 包含 1 不证明剂量成比例；也不能只凭 b 接近 1 得出等效结论。: A CI containing 1 does not prove dose proportionality; a point estimate near 1 does not establish equivalence.
判定需事先确认剂量范围、置信水平和有科学依据的允许界限；没有界限则只报告估计和: Prespecify dose range, confidence level, and scientifically justified bounds. Without bounds, report estimates and CIs only.
不默认套用 0.80–1.25；它不是所有动物 PK 项目的通用标准。: Do not automatically apply 0.80–1.25; these are not universal animal PK acceptance bounds.
残差、异方差、离群点和研究设计需要审查；统计上可拟合不等于样本量充分。: Review residuals, heteroscedasticity, outliers, and study design. A fit being computable does not establish adequate sample size.
rules 是额外科研审计标准；按项目选择、调整与版本化。不是固定执行流程，也不: Rules are additional scientific audit criteria, selected, adjusted, and versioned for each project. They are not a fixed execution workflow or regulatory certification.
先声明描述、指标筛选或人体外推的目标，分别确定证据要求。: State whether the goal is description, index screening, or human extrapolation, with evidence requirements for each.
把拟合成功当成人体预测已验证: Treating successful fitting as validated human prediction
V.C，模型按用途验证: V.C: validation for the intended use
分别记录动物/个体、菌株、孔、重复采样及组汇总，避免伪重复。: Record animals/subjects, strains, wells, repeated samples, and group summaries separately to avoid pseudoreplication.
动物研究；体外实验单位需单独定义: Animal studies; define in vitro experimental units separately
将每个采血点计为独立动物，或把均值还原成个体: Counting each blood sample as an independent animal or reconstructing individuals from means
Essential 10, 1b；对体外部分为项目适配建议: Essential 10, 1b; applying this to in vitro work is a project-specific extension
报告缺口；推断性分析等待确认: Report gaps; defer inference pending confirmation
数据量与采样覆盖按任务判断: Assess data amount and coverage for the task
用参数精度、可辨识性与时间/剂量覆盖评价充分性；不设固定物种数。: Use parameter precision, identifiability, and time/dose coverage to assess adequacy; no fixed species count.
依赖参数估计或预测的任务: Tasks requiring parameter estimation or prediction
三物种或固定 N 就自动足够: Automatically declaring three species or a fixed N adequate
